question: Must this PR demonstrate the Team Standard mapping on a real Claude browser account, or should the maintained synthetic fixtures and partial Premium proof receive an explicit proof override?
rationale: Automation cannot obtain a contributor’s Team Standard account, while the unverified upstream seat-tier value is the only remaining merge gate after the maintainer rewrite resolved the source-boundary findings.

options.title: Require Team Standard proof
options.body: Wait for a redacted screenshot, recording, live output, or runtime log showing a real Team Standard account rendered with the intended label.

options.title: Accept synthetic coverage
options.body: Apply an explicit proof override and accept the exact API fixtures, fallback tests, and existing Premium-side evidence without live Standard validation.

recommendation.title: Require Team Standard proof
recommendation.body: Wait for a redacted screenshot, recording, live output, or runtime log showing a real Team Standard account rendered with the intended label.

likelyOwner.reason: The current head is their focused rewrite, making them the clearest available owner for deciding whether its synthetic Standard validation is sufficient.
